## Overview

**Computer Component Price Analysis** — part of the [Data Science Projects Collection](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-). Khmer24 PC parts (1,055 rows): Ridge, Lasso, tree, and forest models per project guideline.

## Background & Motivation

**Group 2 — PC Component price analysis** (PDS guideline on repo).

PC builders face volatile component pricing (GPU, CPU, RAM). Systematic tracking clarifies fair pay-for-spec across Khmer24 listings.

## Project Guidelines & Objectives

**From *Project Guideline: PC Component price analysis*:**

- **Objective:** PC component **price prediction model** with strong accuracy
- **Data:** Khmer24 dataset — **11 features, 1,055 rows**
- **Steps:** Preprocessing (missing values, duplicates, outliers) → EDA (correlation, feature engineering/selection, transforms) → Models: **Multiple Linear Regression, Ridge, Lasso, Decision Tree, Random Forest** → Train/validation/test with **cross-validation**

## Data Collection & Preparation

Khmer24 scraped listings — 1,055 observations, 11 features per guideline.

## Methodology & Analysis

Correlation plots vs. price; feature engineering and selection; compare linear, regularized, tree, and ensemble regressors.

## Model Evaluation

Cross-validated performance on validation and test splits.

## Results & Key Learnings

Component price benchmarks and model comparison report for DIY PC market analytics.
